_howto: Add a document: drop the PDF into assets/agendas/, then add { year, title, file } to the matching list below (annual = Annual Meetings, board = Board Meetings, mayor = Mayor's Office Meetings), e.g. { "year": 2026, "title": "Annual Meeting 2026 — agenda", "file": "assets/agendas/annual-2026-agenda.pdf" }. Lists render newest year first; entries without a "file" render as unlinked titles. The entries below are PLACEHOLDERS — replace them as real PDFs come in.
